blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Transforming scholarly PDFs into machine-readable fulltext remains a bottleneck for large-scale information systems.
Recent vision-based parsers improve accuracy, but need GPUs and may introduce noise into the extracted text. GROBID , a modular font-stream parser running on CPU, is the de-facto standard for structuring scientific articles and underpins several of the largest open scholarly corpora.
We pair it with a lightweight CPU detector localising figure, table, and paratext (header, footer, page number) regions, encoded as typed-area masks whose tokens are routed to GROBID ’s specialised models or discarded.
On two PMC corpora, Bioinformatics (1,926 articles) and Materials Science (2,595), scored against JATS with a section-aware structural protocol, our extension improves over plain GROBID on most metrics (NS + 0.025 +0.025 / + 0.013 +0.013 ; + 0.086 +0.086 paragraph recall on Materials Science, d z = 1.08 d_{z}{=}1.08 ), and caption-linked figure recovery improves on both corpora.
On the external Table-BRGM benchmark, table detection recovers F1 0.16 → 0.94 0.16\to 0.94 and table structure follows (GriTS-Top 0.27 → 0.78 0.27\to 0.78 , below the strongest GPU system).
On body text, against four vision-based systems ( Docling , MinerU , olmOCR , dots.ocr ), it has the best paragraph precision on both corpora, the best section detection on Materials Science, and a character error rate within 0.004 of the best GPU parser.
End-to-end on CPU, it costs 2.7 2.7 – 3.2 × 3.2\times less than the cheapest GPU system ( Docling ) and 10 10 – 14 × 14\times less than generative parsers.
blocks.zh:
将学术PDF转化为机器可读全文仍然是大规模信息系统的一个瓶颈。
最近的基于视觉的解析器提高了准确度,但需要GPU,并可能给提取的文本引入噪音. GROBID是一个在CPU上运行的模块化字体流解析器,是构建科学文章的事实上法克托标准,是几个最大的开放学术公司的基础.
我们把它与一个轻量级的CPU探测器本地化图、表格和准文本(标题、页脚、页码)区域配对,它们被编码为打字区面具,其符号被传送到GROBID的专用模型或丢弃。
在两个PMC公司中,生物信息学(1,926篇文章)和材料科学(2,595篇文章)对JATS的分数是具有部分知觉的结构协议,我们的扩展比Plain GROBID在大多数度量衡上有所改进(NS + 0.025 + 0.025 / + 0.013 + 0.013; + 0.086 + 0.086段关于材料科学的回顾,dz = 1.08 d_{z_{z}{=}1.08),与标题相关的数字恢复在两个公司都有所改善。
在表-BRGM外部基准上,表检测恢复了F1 0.16 → 0.94 0.16\to 0.94,表结构如下(GriTS-Top 0.27~ 0.780.27\to 0.78,低于最强的GPU系统).
在身体文本上,相对于四个基于视觉的系统(Docling,MinerU ,olmOCR,dots.ocr ),它拥有两个面团上最精准的段落精度,材料科学上最精准的段落检测,以及最佳GPU解析器的0.04范围内的字符错误率.
在CPU上的端对端,其成本为2.7 2.7 – 3.2 × 3.2\时低于最便宜的GPU系统(Docling),10 – 14 × 14\时低于基因解析器.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Extracting text and structure from scientific literature underpins knowledge-graph construction ( Foppiano et al., 2019 ; Jeangirard, 2019 ; Lo et al., 2020 ; Du et al., 2021 ; Foppiano et al., 2023 ; Ammar et al., 2018 ; Jaradeh et al., 2019 ) , dense retrieval ( Karpukhin et al., 2020 ) and retrieval-augmented generation ( Gupta et al., 2026 ; Lewis et al., 2020 ) and parsing errors propagate downstream.
Scholarly PDFs make that hard: multi-column text, multi-panel figures, irregular tables, mathematical notation, and floating captions ( Lopez, 2009 ; Zhu and Cole, 2022 ) .
A recent generation of vision-based parsers works from the rendered page instead, reading layout from the image and recovering text with OCR or a vision-language model ( Ke et al., 2025 ) ; they differ in how much of the page goes to a generative model and how much to dedicated recognisers (§ 2 ).
blocks.zh:
从科学文献中提取文本和结构支撑了知识图的构建(Foppiano等人,2019年;Jeangirard等人,2019年;Lo等人,2020年;Du等人,2021年;Foppiano等人,2023年;Ammar等人,2018年;Jaradeh等人,2019年),密集检索(Karpukhin等人,2020年)和检索授标一代(Gupta等人,2026年;Lewis等人,2020年),并解析下游传播的错误.
学者的 PDF 使这种硬化: 多列文本、 多板块数字、 不规则的表格、 数学符号和浮动标题 (洛佩兹,2009;朱和科尔,2022).
近代基于视觉的解析器从提供的页面中工作,从图像中读出布局,并用OCR或视觉语言模型(Ke等人,2025年)恢复文本;它们在页面中有多少流向基因模型和多少流向专用识别器(§2)方面有所不同。

blocks.en: Full-page vision-based parsing needs GPUs at scale, out of reach for many academic groups; autoregressive generation over page images limits throughput ( Liao et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) ; and reconstructing text from images rather than from the content stream may introduce transcription errors or hallucination ( Kydlíček et al., 2025 ) in technical content such as gene names, chemical formulas and mathematical notation ( Thapa et al., 2024 ; Tong et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 全页视觉解析需要大规模GPU,许多学术团体都无法达到;在页面图像限制吞吐量上自递生成(廖等人,2026年;李等人,2026年);从图像而非内容流中重建文本可能会在基因名称,化学公式和数学符号等技术内容中引入抄录错误或幻觉(Kydlíček等人,2025年) (Thapa等人,2024年;Tong等人,2026年).

blocks.en:
In contrast, GROBID ( GROBID contributors, 2008 ) is a font-stream parser that reads the PDF content directly, yielding high character-level accuracy on commodity CPUs at scale ( Foppiano et al., 2026 ) , and is the standard tool in scholarly infrastructure, producing the parsed full-text behind large open corpora and bibliographic services ( Lo et al., 2020 ; Du et al., 2021 ; Jeangirard, 2019 ) .
Its weak point is visually complex pages: figures and tables interrupt the reading order or leak into the surrounding paragraphs ( Li et al., 2019 ; Soric et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
相比之下,GROBID(GROBID 撰稿人,2008年)是一款字体流解器,直接读取PDF内容,在规模化的商品CPU上产生高字符级精度(Foppiano等人,2026年),是学术基础设施中的标准工具,在大型开放公司和书目服务背后产生解析的全文(Lo等人,2020年;Du等人,2021年;Jeangirard,2019年).
其弱点为视觉复杂页:数字和表格中断阅读顺序或漏入周围段落(Li等人,2019年;Soric等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
We take this asymmetry as our starting point: visual processing can be scoped to localisation of visually-rich components (e.g. tables, figures) and paratext (or boilerplate, such as page headers and footers).
We extend GROBID with a lightweight, replaceable object detector that locates figures, tables and paratext.
Its boxes enter the parser as typed areas , region extents, which the cascade honours when deciding which model sees which token.
We evaluate the resulting system, GROBID+PP , on 4,521 PubMed Central (PMC) articles from two corpora against JATS-XML, under a perturbation-validated structural protocol with paired significance tests and a component ablation separating masking from routing, alongside four representative vision-based systems Docling , MinerU , olmOCR , and dots.ocr at measured cost.
blocks.zh:
我们把这种不对称作为起点:视觉处理可以被范围到视觉丰富的组件(如表,图)和准文本(或锅炉板,如页眉和页脚)的本地化.
我们用一个轻量级、可替换的物体探测器来扩展GROBID,以定位数字、表格和参数。
它的框作为打字区域,区域范围输入解析器,级联在决定哪个型号看到哪个符号时会遵守这些区域.
我们评价所形成的系统,即GROBID+PP,对两条PubMed Central(PMC)对JATS-XML的4,521件PubMed Central(PMC)物品,采用扰动验证的结构协议,并配对意义试验和将遮罩与路由分离的部件,同时采用四个具有代表性的基于视觉的系统Docling、MinerU、olmOCR和点.ocr(按计量成本)。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
We group the systems discussed here into three families.
Full-page generative parsers, such as olmOCR Poznanski et al. (2025a) ; Poznanski et al. (2025b) , dots.ocr Li et al. (2025) , and FireRed-OCR Wu et al. (2026) render each page and generate its content autoregressively with a single VLM; full-pipeline document parsers, such as Docling Livathinos et al. (2025) , and PP-StructureV3 PaddlePaddle Team (2023) combine layout analysis with dedicated OCR, table and formula recognisers; region-routed hybrids, such as MinerU 2.5 Niu et al. (2025) and GLM-OCR Duan et al. (2026) apply layout analysis first and route regions to recognisers in parallel (Table 4 ; Appendix A ).
We do not revisit the earlier layout-aware systems VILA Shen et al. (2022) , Nougat Blecher et al. (2023) and Marker Paruchuri (2023) , which the current generation has superseded.
blocks.zh:
我们把这里讨论的系统分成三个家庭。
全页基因解析器,如olmOCR 波兹南斯基等人(2025a);波兹南斯基等人(2025b),点.ocr. Li等人(2025年)和FireRed-OCR Wu et al. (2026) 将每一页内容自动渲染并生成其内容与单VLM;全管文件解析器,如Docling Livathinos et al. (2025),以及PP-StructureV3 PaddlePaddlePaddle Team (2023) 结合布局分析与专用OCR,表和公式识别器;区域路线混合体,如MinerU 2.5 Niu et al. (2025)和GLM-OCR Duan et al. (2026)将布局分析首先应用,并将路由区域应用到平行的识别器上(表4;附录A )。
我们不重温早先的布局意识系统VILA 沈等人(2022年),努加特·布莱彻等人(2023年)和马克·帕鲁丘里(2023年),当代已经取代.

blocks.en: Our extension belongs to the last class: the contribution is orthogonal to the choice of recogniser, showing that the body-text step can be served by a font-stream parser on CPU rather than a VLM, at lower cost.
blocks.zh: 我们的扩展属于最后一个类: 贡献是正交的, 用于选择识别器, 显示正文脚步可以用在 CPU 上的字体流解析器而不是 VLM 来服务, 费用较低 。

blocks.en: 3 Layout-Masked GROBID
blocks.zh: 3 布局- 组合成 GROBID

blocks.en:
GROBID parses a PDF as a cascade of token-labelling models over the font stream. pdfalto converts the content stream into layout tokens, each carrying its page, bounding box, and font attributes. A segmentation model labels blocks of those tokens into document zones, separating body, and annex from header, bibliography, footnotes, and running headers; a fulltext model then labels each token of the body and annex as paragraph, section title, figure, table, equation, list item or reference marker.
Contiguous spans labelled figure or table go to two specialised models that recover the caption, label, and content of each region. The tokens that remain form the body text, and every stage’s output is serialised into one TEI-XML document. GROBID+PP , as shown in Figure 1 , changes which tokens the fulltext model sees.
blocks.zh:
GROBID 将 PDF 描述为字体流上的符号标签模型的级联 。 pdfalto将内容流转换为布局符号,每个符号都带有其页面,边框,以及字体属性. 一个分割模型将这些符号的块划入文档区域,将正文和附件从标题、书目、脚注和运行标题中分离出来;一个全文模型将正文和附件的每个符号标为段落、标题、图、表格、方程式、列表项目或参考标记。
贴上标签的图或表格的毗连度分为两个专门模型,回收每个区域的标题、标签和内容。 留下的符号构成正文文本,每个阶段的输出被序列化为一个TEI-XML文档. GROBID+PP, 如图1所示, 更改表示整个模型看到的符号 。

blocks.en:
Figure 1: Layout-masked GROBID . The detector localises regions, which reach GROBID as typed areas: tokens inside figure/table boxes are withheld from the fulltext model and dispatched by bounding-box match to the existing figure and table models, tokens inside paratext boxes are discarded.
Those models and the TEI writer are identical to plain GROBID ’s; only the dispatch differs.
blocks.zh:
图1:布局图 探测器定位区域作为打字区域到达GROBID:图框/表框内的信号从全文模型中扣留,并通过与现有图和表模型的边框匹配发送,参数框内的信号被丢弃.
这些模型和TEI编剧与Plain GROBID完全相同;只有发送方式不同。

blocks.en:
Each page is rasterised and passed to the PaddlePaddle PP-DocLayout Sun et al. (2025) model, a lightweight object detector returning typed bounding boxes.
We select PP-DocLayout-L on accuracy-to-latency against its S/M variants and LADaS Clérice et al. (2024) on the DocLayNet validation set Pfitzmann et al. (2022) , scoring the five DocLayNet classes that GROBID+PP masks: mean A ​ P 50 AP_{50} 0.552 0.552 (see Table 6 ) at 0.47 0.47 s/page (Table 5 ; Appendix B ).
We keep six detector classes: figure, table, caption, running-head, footer and page-number, normalised to PDF page coordinates.
Page numbers score under DocLayNet’s page-footer class, and the last three are the paratext class.
Each figure or table box is assigned to the nearest caption on its page, and all boxes sharing a caption are replaced by their union with it (Appendix B ).
This is what turns a multi-panel figure, which the detector reports as one box per panel, back into a single region; a box with no caption nearby is kept on its own.
Three labels reach GROBID : figure, table and paratext; § 5.4 measures what this merging is worth.
blocks.zh:
每页均经过光圈,并传递给PaddlePP-DocLayout Sun等人. (2025)型号,一种轻量级物体探测器返回打入的边框.
我们对照其S/M变体选择关于精度与纬度的PP-DocLayout-L,在DcLayNet验证装置Pfitzmann等人(2022年)上选择LADAS Clérice等人(2024年),将GROBID+PP口罩的5个DcLayNet类别评为:A P 50 AP_{50}0.552 0.552(见表6),为0.47 0.47 s/p(表5;附录B)。
我们保留了六个探测器类别:图,表,标题,运行头,页脚和页码,正常化为PDF页面坐标.
页面号码在DocLayNet的页脚类下得分,最后三个是参数类.
每个图或表格框被分配到其页面上最近的标题,所有共享一个标题的框都会被它们用它的联盟替换(附录B ).
探测器报告为每面板一个盒子的多层图正因此变成一个单一的区域;附近没有标题的盒子是自己保存的。
3个标签达到了GROBID:图、表和参数;第5.4节衡量这种合并的价值。

blocks.en:
A typed area is a rectangle on a page, labelled figure , table or paratext ; the detector produces one list per document, which GROBID takes alongside the PDF through its existing API.
Plain GROBID lets the fulltext model decide which tokens are figure or table content, and typed areas make that decision instead: a token inside a figure or table area skips the fulltext model and goes to the figure or table model with the rest of its area, exactly as if the fulltext model had labelled it so; a token inside a paratext area is dropped; every other token is labelled as before.
Masking changes which model sees a token, not what that model does with it, and the TEI schema is unchanged.
blocks.zh:
键入区域是页面上的矩形、标签图、表格或参数;探测器每个文档生成一个列表,GROBID通过现有的API与PDF并列。
Plain GROBID 让全文模型决定哪个是图或表内容,而打字区域则作出这个决定:一个图或表区域内的符号跳过全文模型,和它的其他地区一起到图或表模型上,就像全文模型给它贴上标签一样;一个参数区域内的符号被丢弃;所有其他符号都像以前一样贴上标签.
假面改变哪个模型看到一个符号,而不是那个模型用它做什么,TEI的图案不变.

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4. 评价

blocks.en: 4.1 Data and Reference
blocks.zh: 4.1 数据和参考

blocks.en:
We evaluate on two subsets of the PMC Open Access CC-BY corpus: every article ships with a publisher JATS-XML file usable as a body-text reference without manual annotation, and CC-BY lets us redistribute the data with the code.
PMC Bioinformatics corpus comprises 1,943 life-science and medical articles (22,431 pages, 11.55 pages/document) Constantin et al. (2013) .
PMC Materials Science comprises 2,595 articles (41,652 pages, 16.05 pages/document) dense in chemical formulas and irregular experimental tables, assembled with ScilitMiner Gupta et al. (2026) from the keywords materials science , physics , chemistry : of 4,000 retrieved documents, 2,595 had a valid PDF and a matching JATS file.
The two differ in period (84% of Bioinformatics from 2010–2011, 67% of Materials Science from 2019–2023): they are contrasting ingestion workloads, not a controlled comparison of domains.
The corpora are English except for two Bioinformatics articles.
blocks.zh:
我们评价了PMC开放访问CC-BY程序的两个子集:每艘装有发布器的JATS-XML文件作为体文本参考而无需手动注释,CC-BY让我们用代码重新分配数据.
PMC 移动 生物信息体包括1 943篇生命科学和医学文章(22 431页,11.55页/文件) Constantin等人(2013年).
PMC 移动 科学包括2,595篇文章(41,652页,16.05页/文件)密集的化学公式和不规则的实验表,与Scilitminer Gupta等人(2026年)从关键词材料科学、物理、化学中组装在一起:在4,000份检索到的文件中,2,595份有有效的PDF和一个匹配的JATS文件。
两者在时期不同(2010–2011年占生物信息学的84%,2019–2023年占材料科学的67%):它们对比的是摄入工作量,而不是域的控制比较.
蝎子是英语,除了两篇生物信息学的文章.

blocks.en: To avoid biasing the results, we resolved both corpora against GROBID ’s training data by DOI and by PDF checksum: only 17 Bioinformatics articles overlap and are excluded from every score reported here, for every system, so the comparisons remain paired; Bioinformatics is scored on n = 1,926 n=1{,}926 .
blocks.zh: 为了避免对结果产生偏见,我们解决了公司与DOI和PDF校验数据对比的问题:只有17篇生物信息学文章相互重叠,并被排除在本文所报道的每一分数之外,对于每个系统来说,因此比较仍然成对;生物信息学的得分是n=1,926 n=1{,}926。

blocks.en:
The reference for the body text is the JATS <body> plus the back matter other than the reference list, footnotes and glossary: <ack> , <back> <sec> , <notes> and appendices are part of the target, as are paragraphs nested in lists and boxes.
Front matter, the reference list, footnotes, figures, tables, and display equations with their captions are excluded.
Figures and tables are scored on their own.
Figure recovery is scored against the JATS <fig> captions of the same corpora (§ 5.3 ).
Table structure needs cell annotations JATS does not supply, so it is scored on the four datasets of Soric et al. (2025) , PubTables , Table-arXiv , Table-BRGM and ICDAR-2013 (§ 5.2 ).
The oracle bound on detector error uses a third PMC corpus of 665 articles for which PubLayNet ( Zhong et al., 2019 ) provides human-annotated figure and table boxes (§ 5.4 ).
blocks.zh:
主体文本的参考是JATS <body> 加上参考列表、脚注和词汇表以外的背面事项:<ack>、<back><sec>、<note>和附录是目标的一部分,各段与列表和框中嵌入的段落一样。
前题,参考列表,脚注,数字,表格,以及带有标题的显示方程式不在此列.
数字和表格都是自己打的。
数字恢复的得分是相对于同一蝎子的JATS <fig>标题(第5.3节).
表结构需要单元格说明JATS不提供,因此它在Soric等人(2025年),PubTables,Table-arXiv,Table-BRGM和ICDAR-2013(§ 5.2)的四套数据集上得分.
在探测器错误上绑定的甲骨文使用了由665件物品组成的第三套PMC文集,PubLayNet(Zhong等人,2019年)为此提供了人类附加说明的图和表框(§5.4).

blocks.en: 4.2 Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.2 计量

blocks.en:
All metrics are computed per document and macro-averaged. NS ( ↑ \uparrow ) is the normalised Levenshtein similarity between reference and predicted body text. WER ( ↓ \downarrow ) and CER ( ↓ \downarrow ) are the word and character error rates; reading them together tells whether an error is a misread character or a wrong word boundary.
For structure we match titles and paragraphs one-to-one with the Hungarian algorithm and report Sec F1 for section detection, Sec τ \tau (Kendall’s τ b \tau_{b} ) for the order of the matched sections, P → \to S for the share of matched paragraphs whose predicted section is the match of their gold section, and Para P/R for paragraph detection.
Because Sec τ \tau is computed on matched sections only, a missing section counts against Sec F1 and not against the order.
Appendix F gives the definitions.
Table 13 checks the suite on perturbed copies of the reference: each perturbation moves the one score meant to catch it and leaves the others at identity.
blocks.zh:
所有衡量标准都是按文件和宏观平均值计算的。 NS( \\ oparrow ) 是参考文本和预言文本之间的常态莱文施泰因相似性 。 WER (\\ downarrow ) 和 CER (\\\ downarrow ) 是单词和字符错误率; 把它们一起读, 说明一个错误是误读的字符还是错误的字词边界 。
关于结构,我们将标题和段落与匈牙利算法一对一相匹配,并报告Sec F1用于分区检测,Sec\\ tau(Kendall的\ b\ tau\ b})用于对应分区的顺序,P\\\ t S用于对应段落的比重,其预想部分为黄金分区的匹配,P/R用于段落检测。
因为 Sec \ tau 只在匹配的段落中计算,所以缺失的段落算Sec F1而不是按顺序计算.
附 录 F给出了定义。
表13以扰动的参考文献副本检查套房:每次扰动都会移动原本要捕捉的得分,让其他的有身份.

blocks.en: 4.3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.3 实验设置

blocks.en:
Scoring happens in one representation every format can express, an ordered sequence of sections, each a plain-text title followed by plain-text paragraphs, into which reference and predictions are projected independently.
The elements excluded from the reference in § 4.1 are removed from the predictions too, but by different means: structurally for the JATS and for GROBID ’s TEI, which mark the body, and by rules for the four vision-based systems, whose JSON or Markdown output carries headings and blocks but no body boundary.
No converter reads the reference or another system’s output (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh:
每个格式都能够用一种表示方式来表示,按顺序排列各节,每节都有一个纯文本标题,后面是纯文本段落,其中参考和预测是独立预测的。
第4.1节中不包括的元素也从预测中去除,但通过不同方式:结构上为JATS和GROBID的TEI(标定机身),规则上为四个基于视觉的系统,其JSON或Markdown输出带有标题和块,但没有实体边界.

blocks.en:
Every system runs on the same document set, paired on the intersection where a baseline returned no parsable output (at most three documents).
Each baseline is compared to GROBID+PP per metric with a paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test, Holm-corrected across system pairs; NS carries a Student- t t 95% confidence interval, and effect sizes are Cohen’s d z d_{z} on the paired differences.
Comparing GROBID+PP against plain GROBID , gains are significant on every metric on both corpora except section order, at ceiling for both.
On Bioinformatics the gains are led by lexical fidelity and paragraph precision (NS + 0.025 +0.025 , d z = 0.48 d_{z}{=}0.48 ; WER − 0.036 -0.036 ; Para P + 0.035 +0.035 ); on Materials Science the lexical gain is smaller (NS + 0.013 +0.013 ) but the structural one far larger, paragraph recall + 0.086 +0.086 ( d z = 1.08 d_{z}{=}1.08 ), the largest masked-versus-plain effect in the benchmark.
Improvement is broad: 65 % 65\% and 56 % 56\% of documents gain NS against 22 % 22\% and 11 % 11\% that lose, and gains above 0.01 0.01 outnumber losses above 0.01 0.01 by 4.5 : 1 4.5{:}1 and 8 : 1 8{:}1 .

Against the vision-based systems the picture splits by metric family.
On structure, GROBID+PP has the best paragraph precision on both corpora ( 0.885 0.885 and 0.901 0.901 ; nearest GPU system 0.849 0.849 and 0.879 0.879 ) and the best section detection on Materials Science ( 0.881 0.881 against 0.799 0.799 for dots.ocr and 0.705 0.705 for olmOCR ).
At the character level GROBID+PP is at par with the best generative system (CER 0.069 0.069 vs. MinerU ’s 0.066 0.066 ; 0.061 0.061 vs. dots.ocr ’s 0.057 0.057 ; d z = 0.03 d_{z}{=}0.03 on both); at the word level the generative parsers pull ahead on Materials Science ( dots.ocr 0.059 0.059 WER, olmOCR 0.086 0.086 , against 0.105 0.105 ), while MinerU ties on Bioinformatics (ns).
A WER gap without a CER gap means the residual errors are word boundaries, not characters: spacing around formulas, units and symbols, and de-hyphenation, which a page-rendering model reads from the image and a content-stream parser must infer from glyph positions.
The vision systems otherwise trade paragraph precision for recall, the signature of fragmented output ( Docling 0.685 0.685 vs. our 0.885 0.885 on Bioinformatics). MinerU 2.5 , which shares our architecture (Table 4 ), is the most informative baseline: GROBID+PP leads it on section detection and paragraph precision, by a wide margin on Materials Science, while it recovers more paragraphs and places matched ones more accurately.
Routing is common ground; what the comparison isolates is where the routed regions go, to a vision-language model or to sequence labellers over the font stream.
The font-stream route wins on structure and cost (§ 5.5 ), the visual route on word segmentation of chemical text.

blocks.en: 5.2 Table Extraction
blocks.zh: 5.2 采掘表

blocks.en:
We assess table extraction with the benchmark of Soric et al. (2025) (§ 4.1 ), scored by detection F1, GriTS and TEDS, with cells matched by bounding-box IoU or by text tokens (Appendix F ).
We compare plain GROBID , GROBID+PP and Docling , the benchmark’s strongest tool; Table 2 summarises bbox mode, with the rest in Appendix H .

blocks.en:
GROBID+PP improves plain GROBID on every dataset and metric in both matching modes, qualitatively so on BRGM and ICDAR where it essentially fails.
The table model is unchanged; it is simply handed a correctly bounded region (§ 5.4 places this gain in the routing half).
Detection is now uniformly high, bbox F1 0.926 0.926 – 0.975 0.975 against 0.157 0.157 – 0.666 0.666 for plain GROBID and above Docling ’s on arXiv and BRGM, so region bounding is no longer the limiting factor; Docling keeps the lead on structure quality on three of four datasets.
The deficit that remains is concentrated in cell content (GriTS Con 0.02 0.02 – 0.16 0.16 lower, TEDS 0.07 0.07 – 0.21 0.21 ) and is produced by the one component the extension leaves untouched, a table model trained on 75 instances from 22 documents; more annotated regions, rather than better boxes, is the natural next lever.
The effect reproduces on a second, independent benchmark: on the scientific-article subset of OmniDocBench GROBID+PP raises TEDS from 31.5 31.5 to 54.7 54.7 (Appendix K ).

blocks.en: 5.4 Ablations of masking and routing
blocks.zh: 5.4 蒙面和路由障碍

blocks.en:
Masking and routing move together in the comparisons above, so we ablated them separately (Appendix D ).
Masking produces the body-text gain in full: routing is worth + 0.0003 +0.0003 NS on Bioinformatics and − 0.0002 -0.0002 on Materials Science ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
That follows from the mechanism (§ 3 ): routed regions leave the body stream, so routing can only withhold body text, never add it.
Routing is instead what keeps masking from being destructive: without it, figure recovery collapses (F1 0.858 → 0.111 0.858\to 0.111 on Materials Science) and tables emitted fall from 4,122 4{,}122 over 1,391 1{,}391 documents to 17 17 over 13 13 .

Masking完全产生体文本增益:生物信息学的路由值+0.0003+0.0003 NS,材料科学的−0.0002-0.0002 (p < 0.001 p < 0.001)。
这从机理(§3): 路由区域离开车体流,所以车体流只能保留车体文字,从不添加.
相反,摇摆是防止破坏的原因:没有摇摆,数字恢复崩溃(F1 0.858 → 0.111 0.858\to 0.11,关于材料科学)和排放的表格从4,122 4{,}122 超过1,391 1{,}391份文件下降到17 17 13份。

The detector already collects 87% of what masking those region types can deliver.
Region formation matters more than box accuracy: the deployed configuration reaches 0.9393 0.9393 , + 0.0143 +0.0143 over the matched run and twenty times the remaining headroom, and two further arms attribute + 0.0133 +0.0133 of it to caption-anchored merging (95% CI [ + 0.0114 , + 0.0151 ] [+0.0114,+0.0151] ), + 0.0011 +0.0011 to paratext and nothing to masking the unannotated pages (Appendix C ).

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
For born-digital scientific PDFs the results support a narrow, practically useful claim, which GROBID +PP instantiates: a font-stream parser, given only the location of non-textual regions from a cheap detector, recovers paragraphs, section structure, and table regions it otherwise loses, at CPU cost.
On 4,521 PMC articles GROBID +PP improves section detection and paragraph recovery (up to + 0.09 +0.09 recall), lowers error rates, restores the table detection that font-stream parsing loses along with much of the structure that depends on it, and improves caption-linked figure recovery, at 2.7 2.7 – 3.2 × 3.2\times below the cheapest GPU parser.
The gain sits in structure rather than raw transcription, consistent with the intended mechanism: the extension changes which tokens the text model sees, not how it transcribes them; the strongest generative parsers match it at the character level (CER within 0.004 0.004 , d z = 0.03 d_{z}{=}0.03 ) and lead only at the word level on chemical text, at ten times the cost.
Withholding tokens produces the body-text gain; routing them to the figure and table models keeps that withholding from destroying the figures and tables. What decides whether an external box helps is its granularity, one region per logical figure rather than per visual panel (§ 5.3 ).
Code, GROBID build, projected references and per-document scores will be released with the paper.

初生数码科学 PDFs 的结果支持一个狭义的,实用的主张,GROBID + PP 即时解析器:一个字体流解解解析器,因为只从廉价的探测器中找到非文字区域的位置,以CPU的成本回收段落,段落结构,以及它原本损失的表格区域.
在4,521 PMC文章 GROBID + PP 上改进了节段检测和段落恢复(最高+0.09+0.09 recept),降低了误差率,恢复了字体流解与依赖它的大部分结构同时丢失的表检测,并改进了标题链接的数字恢复,为2.7 2.7 – 3.2 × 3.2\时间低于最便宜的 GPU 解析器.
增益坐落在结构上而不是原始的抄录上,与预期机制一致:表示文本模型所见的扩展变化,而不是它如何翻录它们;最强的基因剖析器在字符级别(CER在0.004 0.004以内,dz = 0.03 d_{z}{=}0.03)上与它相匹配,只在化学文本的单词级别上领先,成本为10倍.
持有令牌产生体文字增益;将其引向数字和表格模型,使拒绝者不破坏数字和表格。 决定外框是否有帮助的是其颗粒性,每个逻辑数字一个区域而不是每个视觉面板(§5.3).
代码,GROBID构建,预测参考和每份文件的分数将随论文一同发布.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
The section-aware suite scores the flat section sequence: JATS XML section nesting (hierarchy depth) and the reading order of figures and tables are not evaluated.
Sec τ \tau is undefined for documents with fewer than two matched sections and excludes them, and P → \to S conditions on matched paragraphs, so it must be read together with paragraph precision/recall.
Within-section paragraph order is part of the suite but at ceiling ( ≥ 0.985 \geq 0.985 ) for every system, so it is reported only in the appendix.
Because the JATS reference has no coordinates, the figure numbers measure caption recovery and figure-set size, not whether a region is drawn in the right place; a coordinate-bearing reference such as DocLayNet would support an IoU evaluation.
blocks.zh:
区意识套房对平面区段序列进行评分:JATS XML区段筑巢(等级深度),不评价数字和表格的读取顺序.
sec \ tau对于少于两个匹配部分的文件没有定义,而将其排除在外,P \\ to S 对匹配段落的条件,因此必须结合段落的准确性/回顾来阅读。
第1款内的顺序是套间的一部分,但每个系统的上限为0.985\geq 0.985,因此仅在附录中报告。
由于JATS参考文献没有坐标,因此图数字会测量标题恢复和图集大小,而不是一个区域是否在正确位置绘制;像DocLayNet这样的坐标参考文献会支持IoU评价.

blocks.en:
Both corpora are born-digital, English, PMC-hosted CC-BY articles with a valid content stream and a matching JATS XML file; the evaluation does not cover scanned pages, non-English text or publishers outside that subset.
Domain, publisher and era are also confounded across the two: Bioinformatics is publisher-diverse and predominantly from 2010–2011, Materials Science largely single-publisher and predominantly from 2019–2023.
Layouts of the earlier period are on the whole simpler than current multi-panel, heavily floated ones, which likely flatters every font-stream result on Bioinformatics.
Differences between the corpora therefore cannot be attributed to scientific domain or layout complexity specifically.
The paired comparisons within each corpus are unaffected, since every system processes the same documents; what remains open is how far the results transfer to other publishers, periods and collections.
blocks.zh:
两者的corpora都是天生数码,英语,PMC托管的CC-BY文章,其内容流有效,并匹配JATS XML文件;评价不涵盖扫描页,非英语文本或该子集以外的发布者.
领域、出版商和时代也令人困惑: 生物信息学是出版社-多元化的,主要从2010-2011年开始,材料科学主要从单一出版社开始,主要从2019-2023年开始.
早期的布局总体上比现在的多板块多板块更简单,大量漂浮,这可能会夸大生物信息学上每个字体流的结果.
因此,公司之间的差别不能归因于科学领域或具体布局的复杂性。
由于每个系统都处理同样的文件,因此每个机构内部的配对比较没有受到影响;目前尚未确定的是,结果转移到其他出版商、出版期和收藏的程度。

blocks.en:
The detector is selected on detection quality over the masked classes and CPU latency (Tables 5 and 6 ), not end-to-end: we do not run the S/M/L variants through the full pipeline, so the choice rests on the proxy those tables measure rather than on the fulltext scores the pipeline produces. That comparison may also understate LADaS , which is scored on DocLayNet, a corpus that does not cover the historical documents LADaS targets.
The component ablation (§ 5.4 , Appendix D ) separates paratext masking, figure/table masking and routing on the two main corpora, but region formation is isolated only on the PubLayNet corpus (Appendix C ), where caption-anchored merging is worth + 0.013 +0.013 NS; its value on the main corpora is not measured. The masking-only arm is likewise a floor rather than a tuned masking-only system: it routes nothing, so what it reports is GROBID ’s unaided figure and table detection over a token stream that masking has already depleted.
The oracle bound (Appendix C ) closes the detector question for body text only, on a third corpus and for figure and table masks alone; it inherits PubLayNet’s box conventions as the definition of a perfect box, and it says nothing about table structure , so how much of the residual gap to Docling on tables is detector error remains open.
blocks.zh:
检测器是在蒙面类和CPU空档(表5和表6)的检测质量上选择的,而不是端到端:我们不通过全管运行S/M/L变体,因此选择取决于这些表格的代理计量,而不是管道产生的满文评分. 这一比较也可能低估了LADAS的描述,它得分在DocLayNet上,而这个程序并不涵盖历史文件LADAS的目标。
构件膨胀(§ 5.4,附录D)分离了两个主要蝎子上的参数遮盖,图/表遮盖和路由,但区域形成只在PubLayNetacent(Appendix C)上被隔离,其中字幕-安居合并值+0.013+0.013NS;它在主要蝎子上的值没有被测量. 只戴面具的手臂同样是一个地板,而不是一个只戴面具的调制系统:它无路可走,因此它所报告的是GROBID的无助图和一张桌子的探测器,它已经耗尽。
oracle 捆绑(附录 C ) 关闭了检测器问题, 仅用于身体文本、第三体、图和表面具; 它继承了 PubLayNet 的盒式常规, 作为完美框的定义, 并且没有提及表格结构, 因此表上的 Docling 有多少剩余空白是检测器错误, 仍然没有打开。

blocks.en:
The GROBID+PP extension changes where region boundaries come from, not how the figure and table models read what is inside them, and those two remain the least-trained stage of the cascade: 108 figure and 75 table instances, from 28 and 22 annotated documents, respectively (against 925 documents for the segmentation model).
With bounding box detection on the external benchmark now above 0.9 0.9 on every dataset, they are what bounds table-structure quality (§ 5.2 ).
Annotating more figure and table regions is therefore the obvious complementary lever, and an orthogonal one: it needs no architectural change and would be scored by the same protocol.
We did not retrain either model, and this is left for future work.
blocks.zh:
GROBID+PP扩展会改变区域边界的来源,而不是图和表模型如何读出其内部内容,这两个图仍然是级联中训练最少的阶段:分别从28份和22份附加说明的文件(与分区模型的925份文件相比)中,有108个图和75个表实例。
由于每个数据集的外部基准上的边框检测值现在高于0.9,因此它们就是边框表结构的质量(§5.2)。
因此,说明更多的数字和表区域是明显的互补杠杆,也是正统杠杆:它不需要改变建筑结构,将按照同一协议进行评分。
我们没有再培训任何一种模式,而是留给今后的工作。

blocks.en:
The absolute numbers of § 5.5 are one vendor’s on-demand rates on one date, and the two row types rest on different bases (billed spend for GPU systems, measured wall-time priced at the published rate for CPU systems).
The ordering is more robust than the magnitudes, because it follows from the hardware each system requires rather than from the rate card: the extension needs no accelerator at all, so any pricing under which a GPU-hour costs more than a CPU-hour preserves the direction of the comparison, and what moves with the pricing model is the size of the margin.
The comparison against plain GROBID is pricing-independent: both sides run on the same CPU instance, so the 4.7 4.7 – 5.0 × 5.0\times factor is a throughput ratio and carries over to any tariff.
blocks.zh:
第5.5节的绝对数字是一家供应商在一个日期的按需收费率,而两行的种类则基于不同的基础(支付GPU系统的费用,按CPU系统公布的费率计算墙时价格)。
定购比量级要强,因为它从每个系统需要的硬件而非速率卡中产生:扩展完全不需要加速器,因此任何GPU小时成本超过CPU小时的定价都保留了比较方向,而与定价模型移动的是差值大小.
与平原GROBID的对比是价格独立的:双方运行在同一CPU实例上,因此4.7 4.7 — 5.0 — 5.0\时因数是一个吞吐率,并结转到任何关税.

blocks.en:
The decontamination of § 4.1 covers GROBID only, whose training set is small and enumerable.
The vision-based baselines are trained on large page collections assembled from public PDFs, documented at the level of sources rather than documents, and PMC Open Access is a standard source; 67% of Materials Science is from 2019–2023, inside those collections’ time windows.
We could not test either corpus against those training sets, so some of the evaluated pages may have been seen in training.
The effect, if any, favours the baselines, not GROBID+PP .
Those collections also reach well beyond scientific articles, so a scholarly-specialised visual model could close part of the gap; impact on downstream tasks such as retrieval and knowledge-graph construction is left to future work.
blocks.zh:
第4.1节的消除污染只涵盖GROBID,其培训范围小,可以承担。
基于视觉的基线是从公共PDF收集的大页面集成而成的,记录在来源一级而不是文件一级,PMC开放存取是一个标准来源;材料科学的67%来自2019-2023年这些集的时窗内。
我们无法对这些培训进行测试,因此在培训中可能会看到一些评估过的网页。
如果效果有利于基线,而不是GROBID+PP。
这些藏品也远远超出了科学文章的范围,因此,学术专业的视觉模型可以缩小部分差距;对下游任务的影响,如检索和知识图构建,则留给今后的工作。

blocks.en:
Reference and predictions are projected independently and no converter reads the reference (Appendix E ), but the two sides are trimmed by different means: front matter and reference list are removed structurally from the JATS and from GROBID ’s TEI, and by heading rules from the vision-based systems, whose formats carry no structural boundary.
A rule that misses leaves the material in the body and is charged to the system; a rule that fires too early removes body text and is also charged to the system.
The rules were tuned by inspecting system outputs, not scores, but they remain a per-format heuristic that the TEI side does not need.
blocks.zh:
参考和预测是独立预测的,没有转换器读取参考物(Appendix E ),但双方通过不同方式进行修饰:前题和参考物列表在结构上从JATS和GROBID的TEI中移除,通过从基于视觉的系统中标题规则,其格式没有结构边界.
一条规则漏掉将材料留在体内,被充电到系统中;一条规则是过早放火,删除身体文本,也被充电到系统中.
这些规则是通过检查系统输出而不是分数来调整的,但它们仍然是TEI方面不需要的每个格式的heuristic.

blocks.en:
Two pre-filters first remove noise, both taken from GROBID ’s own vector-graphic box calculator: boxes below a minimum area, and boxes wholly contained in a larger box on the same page.
Each surviving box is then assigned to the nearest caption box on its page by edge-to-edge distance, intersecting boxes counting as distance zero, and all boxes sharing a caption are merged with that caption into their bounding union, giving one typed area per caption.
A box whose nearest caption lies beyond a fixed distance is kept as its own region, so uncaptioned artwork is not lost.
blocks.zh:
两个预过滤器首先去除噪音,它们都取自GROBID自己的矢量图框计算器:最小区域以下的框,以及完全装在同一页上更大的框中的框.
每个幸存的框然后按照边缘到边缘的距离分配到其页面上最近的标题框,相互交错的框计为距离0,所有共享标题的框都与该标题合并到其边框中,每个标题给出一个打字区域.
其最接近的标题位于固定距离以外的盒子被保存为自己的区域,所以没有封装的艺术品不会丢失.

blocks.en:
The detector is chosen on detection quality (Appendix B ), which leaves open how much of the pipeline’s residual error is its error.
We bound that directly by replacing the detector with human-annotated boxes and re-running the pipeline unchanged.
blocks.zh:
探测器是按探测质量(附录B)选择的,这就打开了管道剩余误差的多少。
我们直接将它捆绑起来,将探测器更换为人用附加说明的盒子,并不加改变地重新运行管道。

blocks.en:
PubLayNet ( Zhong et al., 2019 ) annotates figure and table regions on renders of PMC articles, so ground-truth boxes and the JATS gold text used throughout this paper exist for the same document.
Its validation split is page-sampled (1.44 pages per document) and cannot support a document-level oracle, so we draw from the train split.
We fetched 2,896 candidate articles from the PMC Cloud service and kept the 665 whose annotations still align with the PDF served today: at least 80% of pages annotated, and at least 90% of PDF words falling inside some annotated region.
Of the 2,231 rejected, 2,060 failed only the page-coverage test, 110 only the word test and 61 both. The word-test failures are cases where the deposited PDF has been replaced since PubLayNet was built in 2019; the page-coverage failures are documents PubLayNet annotated only in part.
This corpus is disjoint from the two evaluation corpora of § 4.1 , so the absolute scores below are not comparable to Table 1 ; only the differences between rows are.
blocks.zh:
PubLayNet(Zhong等人,2019年)对PMC文章的成份作了图表和表格区域的说明,因此,本文中所用的地面真实框和JATS黄金文本就存在于同一文件中。
它的验证分解是页面抽样的(每份文件1.44页),不能支持文件级别甲骨文,所以我们从列车分解中抽取.
我们从PMC Cloud服务处收集了2,896篇候选文章, 并保留了665篇的注解至今仍与PDF一致,
在被拒绝的2,231人中,2,060人仅未能完成封页测试,110人只完成了单词测试,61人都失败了. 单词测试失败是指自PubLayNet于2019年建成以来,已替换已交存的PDF的情况;页面覆盖失败只是部分附加说明的PubLayNet文档.
这套提法与第4.1节的两个评价组合脱节,因此以下的绝对分数与表1不相上下;只有行与行之间的差别.

blocks.en:
Four runs in the first block and four in the second, one GROBID build, one evaluator, 665 documents.
The unmasked run is issued through the same typed-area path with an empty area list, so the conditions differ only in mask content.
The first three are strictly matched: they mask the same categories (figure and table, the only ones PubLayNet annotates) on the same pages (PubLayNet annotates a prefix of each document), so detector and oracle differ only in box quality.
The fourth is the deployed configuration of § 3 , which differs from the matched run in three ways: every page rather than the annotated prefix, caption-anchored unions rather than raw boxes, and paratext.
It is not comparable to the oracle and is reported to separate the value of mask scope from that of box accuracy.
Two intermediate arms then separate the three: figure/table boxes on every page without merging, and caption-merged figure/table regions without paratext.
They were run with the matched and deployed arms on one later build of the same branch, so their rows are comparable with each other (the matched arm reproduces to 0.0001 0.0001 NS) but not digit for digit with the first block.
blocks.zh:
四个在第一个区块运行,四个在第二个区块运行,一个GROBID大楼,一个评价员,665份文件.
未蒙面的运行通过一个空区域列表的同一类型区域路径发布,因此条件仅在遮罩内容上有所不同.

第四是第3节的部署配置,它与匹配的运行在三个方面不同:每页而不是附加说明的前缀,标题-焦虑的结合而不是原始的框,以及参数。
它不能与甲骨文相提并论,据报道它将遮罩范围的价值与箱的准确性的价值区分开来.
然后,两个中间臂将三个部分分开:各页上的数字/表格框不合并,以及标题合在一起的数字/表格区域不带参数。
他们用配对的武器运行在同一个分支后来建造的一座上,因此他们的行可以相互比较(配对的手臂复制到0.0001 0.0001 NS),但与第一个区块的数位不对应.

blocks.en: § 4.3 projects every system’s output and the JATS reference into one common representation. The rules are as follows.
blocks.zh: §4.3将每个系统的产出和JATS的参考信息预测为一个共同代表。 规则如下.

blocks.en: Each document becomes an ordered sequence of sections, each a plain-text title (serialised as a ## line) and an ordered list of plain-text paragraphs. JATS / and TEI <div>/<head> become section titles and their <p> descendants become paragraphs, including paragraphs nested in lists, quotations and boxes; for Markdown/JSON output the corresponding native heading and text-block boundaries are used, and one block is one paragraph. Nested sections are traversed in document order and flattened, because hierarchy depth is not scored, while a paragraph remains attached to the nearest preceding heading supplied by that source. Text before the first heading is retained in an untitled root section. The projection preserves the order and boundaries emitted by each system: it neither splits nor merges paragraphs to improve a match, and it does not repair a system’s labelling. A reference list a system emitted as body text, a running header it promoted to a heading, or an appendix it filed under References is scored as emitted.

JATS /和TEI <div>/<head>成为部分标题,他们的<p>后代成为段落,包括嵌入列表、引文和框中的段落;对于Markdown/JSON输出,使用相应的本地标题和文本块边界,一个块是一个段落。 嵌入的段落按文件顺序排列并平整,因为等级深度没有打分,而一段仍附在该来源提供的最近的标题上。 在无标题的根节中保留第一个标题之前的文字。 投影保留了每个系统发出的顺序和边界:它既不拆分也不合并段落来改进匹配,也不修复系统的标签. 参考文件列出作为正文发布的系统、其晋升到标题的运行中标题或根据参考文件提交的附录被评为已发布。

blocks.en:
Reference and predictions are projected independently, and each converter reads only its own output, never the reference or another system’s output, so the conversion cannot use gold structure.
On the reference side, front matter, the reference list, footnotes, the glossary, and figures, tables and display equations with their captions and labels are removed structurally; <ack> keeps its own title, and Open Access licence statements filed under it are dropped.
On the prediction side, figure and table content is excluded through whatever structure each format supplies: an ancestor test on TEI <figure> , <table> and <formula> for GROBID , block type for MinerU , block category for dots.ocr (which also drops page headers and footers), block label for Docling , and, for olmOCR ’s Markdown, HTML <table> / <figure> blocks and caption blocks opening with a figure or table label followed by a capitalised word.
The reference list is removed when the system placed it under a References -like heading.
Full-page parsers also emit the front matter, which the reference does not contain; it is removed by a rule that reads only the system’s headings: the text before an Introduction -like heading among the leading headings; otherwise the Abstract or Keywords section, ending at its first paragraph without a structured-abstract label so that an unheaded introduction survives; otherwise, for papers that open without such headings, everything before the first run of body text, discarding a title-like leading heading. Sidebar badges promoted to headings ( Open Access , Check for updates , Received / Accepted ) are dropped. The rule that fired is recorded per document. GROBID needs neither step because its TEI marks the body structurally.
For dots.ocr , whose deployment had concatenated per-page output in lexicographic order, the page order is restored from the bounding boxes before projection.

blocks.en: Appendix K OmniDocBench, Scientific-Article Subset
blocks.zh: 附录 K OmniDoc Bench, 科学物品子集

blocks.en:
OmniDocBench scores each page in isolation, whereas GROBID ’s models label one token stream carrying whole-article structure (title block, section sequence, reference list), so a page taken from mid-article gives them nothing to condition on; the extension inherits the constraint, since masking changes only which tokens enter that stream.
The distribution compounds it: v1.5 and v1.6 ship page images and GROBID performs no OCR, so the released benchmark carries no font stream at all, and over the 981 single-page PDFs of the archived v1_0 branch GROBID returns no body text for ≈ 44 % \approx\!44\% of pages (handwritten notes 100 % 100\% , slides 80 % 80\% , textbooks 70 % 70\% ).
The benchmark therefore cannot be run whole against a document-level parser, hence the n/a in Table 4 , but the part of it that is well posed for one can. We therefore evaluate on the intersection of two conditions: v1.5 annotations for pages whose data_source is academic_literature , and for which a source PDF is distributed. Only the archived v1_0 branch ships PDFs, so this yields 129 of the 215 v1.5 academic pages; the remaining 86 were added in v1.5 and exist as images only. All 129 are English and all carry a text layer (median 3,829 characters). The ground truth over them holds 695 text blocks, 161 titles, 260 references, 94 figures, 79 tables and 48 display formulas.
blocks.zh:
OmniDoc Bench对每一页的评分都是孤立的,而GROBID的模型将一个带有整条结构的符号流(标题块,节序,参考列表)标注在标签上,因此从文章中摘取的一页没有条件;扩展继承了约束,因为遮掩的改变只是那些符号进入该流。
分布复合了它:v1.5和v1.6的船页图像和GROBID不执行OCR,所以发布的基准完全没有字体流,在存档的v1_0分支的981单页PDF上,GROBID返回了44%\大约!44%的页的文字(手写注释100%100%,幻灯片80%80%,教科书70%70%)。
因此,该基准不能与文件级别分析器完全对照,因此表4中的n/a,但其中对一个人来说是很好的部分。 因此,我们评价两个条件的交叉点:v1.5 数据来源为学术_文学的页的说明,并分配一个来源PDF。 只有存档的v1_0分支舰只PDF,因此在215 v1.5学术页面中产量为129;其余86页被添加到v1.5中,仅作为图像存在. 所有129个都是英文,都带有文字层(中间3,829个字符). 上面的地面真相有695个文本块、161个标题、260个参考文献、94个数字、79个表格和48个显示公式。

blocks.en: Text edit distance moves the other way by 0.012 0.012 , and the metric’s construction accounts for it: OmniDocBench filters figure_caption , table_caption , the footnote categories, header , footer , page_footnote , page_number and equation_caption out of the ground truth before scoring text blocks. Those are exactly the categories the masking suppresses, so the benefit of paratext masking is invisible to this metric by construction while its marginal cost still registers. This is a difference in what the two protocols measure, not a reversal of the normalised-similarity gains of § 5.1 . Display-formula metrics are not reported: GROBID emits the raw text of an equation rather than L a T e X , so an edit distance against L a T e X ground truth measures that representation mismatch rather than anything the mask changes.
blocks.zh: 文本编辑距离以0.012 0.012 向另一方向移动,而公尺的构造算法是: OmniDoc Bench filters figure_caption, table_caption, 脚注分类, 页眉, page_footnote, page_number and equal_caption 在评分文本块前从地面真理中脱出. 这些正是遮盖抑制剂的类别,因此,通过施工,遮盖准文本的好处是看不见的,而其边际成本却仍在登记。 这是两个协议衡量的区别,而不是逆转第5.1节的常态化-相似性收益。 显示公式度量不报告:GROBID释放出一个方程的原始文本而不是L a T e X,因此对照L a T e X 地面真实度量表示不匹配,而不是任何面具改变.

blocks.en: Two limits apply to these numbers. Each page is still scored in isolation, so both arms are handicapped equally by the missing document context, and neither figure is GROBID ’s behaviour on whole articles. And no vision-based system has been run on this subset, so Table 16 supports the paired within-parser comparison only, and none of its values may be read against the published leaderboard, which scores the full 1,651-page set.
blocks.zh: 这些数字有两个限制。 每一页仍然被孤立地打分,因此两只手臂同样受到缺失的文件背景的阻碍,两个数字都不是GROBID在整个文章上的行为. 而在这个子集上也没有运行基于视觉的系统,因此表16只支持对等的parser内部比较,其任何数值都不得与已公布的导板对读,该导板对整1,651页的集进行评分.
